verdict: The copy is sharp, X-native and honest: the hero line, the bento headlines, the per-word chip explanations and the preview-honest sheet are best-in-class. What keeps it under 9.5 is pricing clarity on phones (the Free scheduling limit reads like a gotcha, and the rewrite Pro sells is never defined there), plus small truth and consistency slips in the receipts, the Studio approve button and lines that repeat.
to_95: Rewrite the Free scheduling limit to lead with the number and say what happens after it ("15 posts a month sent at your time. After that, one tap sends each."), with matching phrasing on phones, Pro and FAQ qa5.
Define a rewrite at every width in one lede line (with Studio's 500/client), and rename the Try tile's "Another take" so "take" only means a paid rewrite.
Make the Studio approve role-play explicit ("Approve as Priya, with her edit"), update the card and queue after approval, and show "posts go out from their X account, never yours" on phones.
Make every hero receipt true: change the Founder example's "Named who did it" to "Number first · Made it active" with a matching why.

Replace the "Trader, founder, writer. / The first line decides." heading, cut the repeated lines (the first-line thesis, "Every cut is marked…", the third disclaimer), and give the final card a fresh trader example.
Use "fluff" as the single term in receipts, with honest phrase counts.
Polish the microcopy: "Use my line", the placeholder, "Clean line", "never mid-word", the ngl put-back text, "Ready for", Jot vs voice note, the sheet title, FAQ qa2/qa3 and the MRR kept row.

issues.where: #pl-free bullet 2 (.desk "Schedule all you like. 15 a month go out at your time; the rest wait for one tap." / .mob "Schedule all you like; 15 a month go out on time"), FAQ #qa5, Pro .mob "500 posts a month go out on time"
issues.problem: The Free plan's defining limit opens with an unlimited claim and then takes it back, so it reads like a gotcha just as people pick a plan. The phone version drops the second half, so "15 a month go out on time" suggests the rest go out late. The sentence also starts with a numeral, and "at your time" (desktop) and "on time" (phone) mean different things.
issues.fix: Lead with the number and say plainly what happens after it. Desktop: "15 posts a month sent at your time. After that, one tap sends each." Phone: "15 auto-sent posts a month, then one tap each". Pro (both widths): "500 posts a month sent at your time". FAQ qa5: "...previews for all four apps, and 15 posts a month sent at your time (after that, you tap to send)." Use "sent at your time" everywhere.

issues.where: .head .lede (hidden at ≤760px); Pro bullet "250 rewrites in your voice a month"; Try tile #try-alt "Another take"
issues.problem: Pro sells rewrites, but the only place that says what a rewrite is ("A rewrite gives you three takes in your voice") is the lede, and phones hide it. X traffic is mostly phones. The free Try tile also offers "Another take", so the paid "three takes" sounds like something visitors just got for free. The lede also says free three times next to a heading that already says it, and it leaves out Studio.
issues.fix: Show one short lede line on every width: "Sharpen is unlimited. A rewrite is three fresh takes in your voice: 20 a month on Free, 250 on Pro, 500 per client on Studio." Rename the Try tile's "Another take" to "Another version", so "take" only ever means a rewrite.

issues.where: #rv-act: "Waiting on Priya" + button "Approve with Priya’s edit"
issues.problem: The ghostwriter's status and the client's button sit in one row, so it reads as if you approve on Priya's behalf. That undercuts "Their yes before anything posts" on the button the eye lands on first.
issues.fix: Make the role-play explicit and the same for every client. Use "Approve as Priya, with her edit" ("Approve as Rafael, with his edit"); Lena and Marco keep "Approve as Lena/Marco". Or caption the card "What Priya sees" and label the button "Approve with my edit".

issues.problem: After approval the card still says "· draft", the approved queue row shows the old text ("Customer churn: down 34%. W…" without "since June"), and Priya's comment now quotes the words it asked for. The tile runs about 120 words on desktop. On phones the key Studio fact, that posts go from the client's own account, is hidden.
issues.fix: On approve, replace "draft" with "scheduled", put the edited text in the queue row, and show the comment on "down 34%" only. Merge facts 1 and 2 into one line shown at every width: "Clients approve from a link. Posts go out from their X account, never yours." Drop the separate "They sign in with X or Google…" line, since FAQ qa4 already says it.

issues.where: EX[1] (Founder): say "Named who did it"; why "34% leads, and saying who did it sounds like you were in the room, not like a press release."
issues.problem: The draft already named "our team". The edit actually turned passive into active and moved the number up, so the receipt is not true. "34% leads" is also off, since "Customer churn:" comes first. The hero examples are the proof, and a wrong receipt weakens "every cut is marked".
issues.fix: Change the engine's strings for this move (the hero syncs from core.js) to say "Number first · Made it active" and why "The number comes first, and “our team redesigned” sounds like you were there. “Was redesigned by” sounds like a press release." Then re-run hero-sync.

issues.where: #w-h "Trader, founder, writer. / The first line decides."
issues.problem: This is the weakest heading on the page: a list plus the thesis repeated almost word for word from the hero meta line ("On X, the first line decides…"). "Writer" is vague (newsletter or ghostwriter?), and the four cards include a ghostwriter that the heading leaves out.
issues.fix: Name what each card opens with and drop the repeated thesis, e.g. "Trades, launches, issues. / Each one opens stronger." Keep it to 2 lines at 390.

issues.where: Jun Park’s design-systems line appears in the hero (Designer), all 3 preview panes, the phone feed and the final card; "Every cut is marked, so you can put any word back." appears in the voice tile body and FAQ qa1; "Example" tags, .who-n and the footer note make three disclaimers
issues.problem: The closing proof repeats the hero's fourth example rather than landing audience #1 (traders), and repeated lines make the page feel longer than it is.
issues.fix: Give the final card a fresh, engine-verified trader line (lowercase, a $ticker, a number). Rewrite the voice tile body as something new, e.g. "Paste 8 of your posts. It picks up your habits and your never-say words." Drop .who-n, since the Example tags and the footer already cover it.

issues.where: #out-st / #pf-move receipts: "Cut 1 filler word", "Cut 2 soft words", "Cut 1 hedge", "Cut the warm-up"; the H2 and chips say "fluff"; the final counter says "3 bits of fluff"
issues.problem: One idea goes by five names. "Cut 3 soft words" (Ghostwriter starter) is shown when six words were struck in three phrases, so the receipt understates the edit.
issues.fix: Use "fluff" as the single umbrella term in receipts and count phrases honestly, e.g. "Cut 3 bits of fluff" to match the final counter. Keep hedge/warm-up/filler only inside the per-chip why lines, where they teach.

issues.problem: "Use my line" actually empties the box, so it reads as if it will fetch or apply something. The placeholder repeats the label word for word. "Clean line" mixes a result into a row of personas and is jargon.
issues.fix: Rename the button "Paste mine" (it clears and focuses). Make the placeholder "Your first line…". Rename the starter "Already sharp" so it sets up "Nothing to cut."

issues.where: .split "Splits at the end of a sentence, never mid-word."
issues.problem: "Never mid-word" is a non-brag, since no tool splits mid-word. At 390 it wraps to "mid-/word."
issues.fix: "Splits between sentences, so each post reads whole." On Bluesky: "Same split as on X."

issues.where: #kp-n before/after: "Put it back a second time, and Sharpen leaves it alone." → one tap → "Kept. Sharpen leaves “ngl” alone from now on."
issues.problem: The first line says it takes two put-backs, then a single tap claims it is permanent.
issues.fix: Before: "You put “ngl” back once already. Once more and it stays." After: "Learned. “ngl” stays from now on."

issues.where: #day-h "Jot it at 11 PM." vs step 1 "You saved a voice note"
issues.problem: "Jot" means writing, but the demo shows a voice note.
issues.fix: Use "Note it at 11 PM." or "Say it at 11 PM.", or keep "Jot" and change step 1 to a typed note.

issues.where: .hmeta .posts "Posts to X LinkedIn · Ready for Threads Bluesky"; .since "It’s the part you control."
issues.problem: "Ready for" reads like "coming soon" or "compatible", while the hero sub promises scheduling for all four. "It’s the part you control" is loose, since you control the whole post.
issues.fix: "Posts to X, LinkedIn · One tap to Threads, Bluesky" (matches FAQ qa2). "On X, the first line decides if anyone reads the second. That’s the line Sharpen works on."

issues.where: #qa2 "Does it post without me?"; Trust tile .rules
issues.problem: The answer runs five sentences (about 70 words) and introduces "plug" and "reruns" mid-answer. The Trust tile uses both terms without defining them.
issues.fix: "Only what you schedule, at the time you pick. X and LinkedIn posts go out then; Threads and Bluesky ping you to post in one tap. Auto-plugs (one reply you write ahead) and reruns stay off until you turn them on. It never DMs, deletes, follows or likes." Trust tile: "Auto-plugs and reruns stay off until you switch them on."

issues.where: #qa3 "Sharpen is an editor: it cuts the fluff and can reorder what’s left"
issues.problem: Sharpen also rephrases and adds connecting words: "What changed:", "why do…?", "Here’s how.", "cannot"→"can’t", "is going to"→"will". A visitor who tests a line will see words the FAQ implies it never adds.
issues.fix: "it cuts the fluff, tightens and reorders what’s left, and never adds a fact or a number."

issues.where: Studio #pl-studio: "Everything in Pro" is bullet 4 (hidden on phones); "500 rewrites a month per client, shared across your clients"
issues.problem: The anchor that makes Studio easy to judge is buried, and the pooled-rewrites line is clunky.
issues.fix: Make "Everything in Pro" bullet 1 at every width. Then use "500 rewrites per client a month, pooled".

issues.where: #sh-t "This is a preview" + #sh-done-t "This is a design preview, so…"; Sign in switch
issues.problem: The title and the first sentence say the same thing. Switching to Sign in after an empty-email submit leaves "Add your email, like you@example.com." showing on the Welcome back sheet.
issues.fix: Title: "Not live yet". Keep the body as is. Hide #sh-err when the mode changes.

issues.where: keptLine on the Founder starter: "Your $10k, your MRR and your 14 months."
issues.problem: "MRR" is a unit, not a kept fact, so the sentence reads oddly.
issues.fix: When an all-caps unit directly follows a number, attach it: "Your $10k MRR and your 14 months."

issues.area: Engine explanations (seen on visitors' own lines)
issues.where: Try tile and final card, via sharpenLine
issues.problem: "I think maybe this could work" → "Maybe this could work." with why "Hedges ask the reader to doubt you. Without them the claim stands on its own.", although the result is still hedged. A capitalized first line with a lowercase second line came back lowercased with "here’s why:" added ("this might be the best quarter we’ve ever had. here’s why:"), which breaks "It still sounds like you" on the very first test.
issues.fix: (For the engine owner.) Show the hedge why only when no hedge is left in the line. Take the first word's case from the first line, not from the rest of the draft.
